title: Maps from an ind-etale algebra into a henselian local ring are determined by the residue map
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a ring homomorphism with $S$ a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_S$, and put $\mathfrak p=$ the preimage of $\mathfrak m_S$ in $R$. Let $A$ be an $R$-algebra which is a filtered colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of $R$-algebras $A_i$ with $\operatorname{Spec}A_i\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] (in particular $A$ may be a single etale $R$-algebra), let $\mathfrak q\subset A$ be a prime lying over $\mathfrak p$, and let $\tau:\kappa(\mathfrak q)\to S/\mathfrak m_S$ be a homomorphism of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-algebras. Then there is exactly one homomorphism of $R$-algebras $f:A\to S$ with $f^{-1}(\mathfrak m_S)=\mathfrak q$ and inducing $\tau$ on residue fields (that is, $A\to S\to S/\mathfrak m_S$ equals $A\to A/\mathfrak q\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)\xrightarrow{\tau}S/\mathfrak m_S$).

source.place: Lemma Tag 08HQ (lemma-map-into-henselian), for a single etale algebra, whose proof uses Lemma Tag 04GG (lemma-characterize-henselian, the retraction of an etale algebra through a point with trivial residue extension) and leaves the verification and uniqueness as 'details omitted'; Lemma Tag 08HR (lemma-map-into-henselian-colimit) for the filtered colimit; Stacks defines henselian by lifting simple roots (Definition Tag 04GF), equivalent to the idempotent-lifting definition of [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] by Lemma Tag 04GG

proof.text: For a single etale R-algebra A, first allow any field K with an S-algebra structure whose algebra map is surjective and has kernel m_S. Put B=S tensor_R A and let phi:B -> K be the S-algebra map given by AlgHom.liftEquiv from chi:A -> K. Base change makes B etale over S. This is the private helper etale_lift_field.

source.place: Tag 08HQ, tensor-product proof and its omitted verification

proof.text: Put q_prime=ker(phi). It is prime since K is a field, and its pullback to S is m_S since phi commutes with S. The residue-field lifts eta:kappa(m_S) -> K and psi:kappa(q_prime) -> K satisfy psi composed with theta=eta, where theta is the canonical residue-field map. The map eta is surjective because S -> K is, and psi is injective because its domain is a field. Given y in kappa(q_prime), choose x with eta(x)=psi(y); injectivity of psi gives theta(x)=y. Thus theta is bijective.

source.place: Tag 08HQ, tensor-product proof and its omitted verification

proof.text: Translate Algebra.Etale S B to scheme etaleness with HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff and RingHom.etale_algebraMap. Apply the existing henselian etale retraction theorem to obtain the unique sigma:B -> S with sigma inverse image of m_S equal to q_prime. Identify the algebra structure (algebraMap S B).toAlgebra with the tensor-product left algebra structure.

source.place: Tag 08HQ, tensor-product proof and its omitted verification

proof.text: The reduction of sigma is phi. For b in B choose s in S with residue(s)=phi(b). Then b-algebraMap(s) lies in q_prime, so sigma(b)-s lies in m_S, proving equality of their residues. Restrict sigma to A to lift chi. Conversely, lift any f:A -> S through AlgHom.liftEquiv. Its reduction agrees with phi on the A tensor factor and on S; tensor-product extensionality gives equality on B and hence the same maximal-ideal preimage. Retraction uniqueness and the inverse lift equivalence give uniqueness of f.

source.place: Tag 08HQ, tensor-product proof and its omitted verification

proof.text: Apply the preceding helper after replacing S and A by ULift S and ULift A in their common universe. Transport henselianity by HenselianLocalRing.of_ringEquiv and etaleness by Algebra.Etale.of_equiv. Use K=kappa(m_S); its algebra map from ULift S is residue composed with the down equivalence, is surjective, and has kernel the maximal ideal because the down equivalence preserves units. Transport the unique lift back to A -> S. This proves the private helper existsUnique_etale_residue_lift for all three original universes.

source.place: Tag 08HQ, tensor-product proof and its omitted verification

proof.text: Using h_tau on the images of R in kappa(p), form chi:A -> kappa(m_S) as tau composed with the canonical residue map; compatibility makes it an R-algebra map. For any f:A -> S the original prime-preimage and residue-field conditions are equivalent to residue composed with f equal to chi: field-map injectivity identifies kernels, and Ideal.ResidueField.ringHom_ext identifies the induced residue maps.

source.place: Tag 08HR, stagewise lifting and filtered-colimit gluing; omitted verifications

proof.text: Transport the colimit cocone across the chosen isomorphism to A. At every stage the single etale helper uniquely lifts chi composed with the coprojection. Along a transition t:i -> j, f_j composed with F(t) has the same reduction as f_i by cocone naturality, so single-etale uniqueness gives compatibility.

source.place: Tag 08HR, stagewise lifting and filtered-colimit gluing; omitted verifications

proof.text: Prove that forgetting this filtered algebra colimit gives a type colimit without requiring R to lie in the universe of the stage algebras: equip Mathlibs commutative-ring filtered colimit with the R-algebra structure induced from one stage, prove independence of the stage by filteredness, and exhibit its algebra colimit universal property. Transport its type-colimit property to A. Use the heterogeneous-universe CoconeTypes descent for the compatible f_i to define A -> S; represent two elements at a common stage to check addition and multiplication, and check constants and R-linearity at one stage.

source.place: Tag 08HR, stagewise lifting and filtered-colimit gluing; omitted verifications

proof.text: Every element of A comes from a stage, so the descended map has reduction chi. The equivalence in step 6 yields exactly the original prime-preimage and residue-map conditions. Any other map satisfying them has reduction chi, and restricts to f_i by single-etale uniqueness. Representing each element at a stage then proves equality with the descended map.

split_report.summary: Split after Stacks 08HQ/08HR, following Stacks' own route for 08HQ (base change B=A(x)_R S, which is etale over S; the prime q' = kernel of A(x)S -> k given by tau and S -> k; the unique retraction sigma of the henselian S through q' by 04GG (1)=>(8); f = sigma o iota_A) rather than the brief's direct standard-etale route, which is the proof of 04GG (1)=>(8) and so belongs one level down in the new node lem-weil-pbc-henselian-etale-retraction (whose source records 00UE, 04GF root lifting, lemma-uniqueness, and the idempotent-lifting equivalence 04GG/09XI needed because def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology is idempotent lifting). The verifications Stacks omits are written out: q' prime over m_S with trivial residue extension; pi o sigma = phi, hence the residue and preimage conditions; uniqueness through sigma's uniqueness; the cocone property of the f_i via the uniqueness at each stage, the conditions on colim f_i elementwise (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise), and uniqueness in the colimit case. Statement kept; def-weil-residue-field added to stmt_deps (kappa(q), kappa(p)). Item searched again: no Mathlib statement about maps into henselian local rings (Mathlib's HenselianLocalRing is root lifting only). New nodes: lem-weil-pbc-henselian-etale-retraction (unsplit), lem-weil-pbc-etale-ring-base-change (Mathlib: Algebra.Etale.baseChange), lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise (Mathlib: Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep with Under.forget preserving connected colimits).

lean.statement: theorem map_into_henselian_colimit (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (S : Type v) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [HenselianLocalRing S] (A : Type w) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (I : Type w) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (F : I ⥤ CommAlgCat.{w} R) [HasColimit F] (hA : Nonempty (colimit F ≅ CommAlgCat.of R A)) (hEtale : ∀ i : I, Algebra.Etale R (F.obj i)) (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p = q.comap (algebraMap R A)) (hm : p = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap (algebraMap R S)) (τ : q.ResidueField →+* (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).ResidueField) (hτ : τ.comp (Ideal.ResidueField.map p q (algebraMap R A) hp) = Ideal.ResidueField.map p (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) (algebraMap R S) hm) : ∃! f : A →ₐ[R] S, ∃ hf : q = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap f.toRingHom, Ideal.ResidueField.map q (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) f.toRingHom hf = τ
